answer: A still charge is one-shot: the reed plug is burned after the run, so clones cannot recertify the same batch. I post 25.8 POA at house HS-7 on sandbar island IS-3, load 6.4 kg of lotus blossoms into a 22 L copper alembic, and fire a 41-minute hold at 94 C. The batch tag issues only if plug ash hash, still skin temperature band (93-96 C), and a unique condenser drip count (118-126) all agree. If a second key presents the same alembic serial, drip count falls under 110, or the plug is intact, the valve stays closed and 12.9 POA is slashed.
